supporters.titleLead: Built with a lot of help.
supporters.lede: LeLibrary turns the files in your TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize account into a real library in Stremio and Nuvio. It is a free, open-source hobby project, and it only works because of the people and projects on this page.
supporters.mission: It began with one goal: open your debrid library, pick a title and press play, without digging through stream lists or stacking up catalogue addons. Everything else grew from that, with a lot of help along the way.

home.title: Your debrid library,
home.hero: LeLibrary turns the files already in your TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize account into a real library in Stremio and Nuvio. Pick a title and your own copy plays straight away. Catalogues, collections and extra streams live in the same addon, so you do not need a stack of others.
home.goalText: LeLibrary connects the files you already have in TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize to the apps you use to watch. Browse an organized movie, series and anime library, with your own playable copy put first.
home.feature1Text: When a connected debrid library already has a playable copy, LeLibrary prioritizes it so supported players can go straight to playback instead of making you choose between duplicate stream results.
home.feature2Text: LeLibrary reuses playable files in your connected provider library, so browsing or playing a saved title does not create another copy.
home.feature3Text: Install LeLibrary in Stremio or send your setup to a Nuvio profile. Your household gets familiar rows and a simpler route from title to playback.
home.feature4Text: Use TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize, alone or together. Browse collections, discovery rows and your library from the same setup.
home.documentTitle: Debrid Library for Nuvio & Stremio | LeLibrary
home.metaDescription: Bring TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize into Nuvio or Stremio. Browse your saved movies, shows and anime, with playable files from your library first.

privacySection.linkText: Installing creates a random unguessable link. Anyone holding it can watch through your setup; nobody else, including us, can tell whose it is. There is no username, email or profile attached to it.
privacySection.keysText: Provider keys are encrypted before they touch disk and are only decrypted in memory while answering your requests. They are never displayed back, logged, or sent anywhere except the provider they belong to.
privacySection.sellText: No analytics, no advertising, no trackers, no fingerprinting, no IP logs, no profiling. We could not sell your data even if we wanted to, because we barely hold any.

staticText.first. Then confirm the setup is using t: first. Then confirm the setup is using the key for the provider that actually holds the download. Make sure the download is complete and contains a playable video file. Active setups refresh in the background, so give a large library a few minutes, then reopen the catalogue. A public status page does not check your individual key.
staticText.Matching works from the download name. C: Matching works from the download name. Check that it includes the correct title and year, and season and episode information for shows. Renaming it at the provider and waiting for a refresh usually fixes it. If it keeps happening, report the expected title and a redacted example filename. Never share a full install link or a provider key.
staticText.Discovery and curated rows include title: Discovery and curated rows include titles you may not own. Look for your own library copy first, or add an external stream addon. If your filters are strict, relax the resolution, size or cached-only rules temporarily. A catalogue listing is not a promise of playback.
staticText.Open the destination step in Move In, co: Open the destination step in Move In, confirm the selected Nuvio profile, and push again. Folder definitions are scoped to a profile. Some changes need the Nuvio client refreshed before they show.
staticText.When you push through LeLibrary, it turn: When you push through LeLibrary, it turns on Nuvio's built-in TMDB enrichment for the selected profile on TV and mobile. For your library rows to use that enrichment, turn on Use Main Meta in LeLibrary so eligible titles are served with IMDb IDs. If you installed the manifest manually, check Nuvio's own enrichment setting for the profile you are using.
staticText.Wait a moment before retrying, and check: Wait a moment before retrying, and check Nuvio first: a request that timed out may have completed anyway. If your Nuvio connection expired, reconnect it in the destination step. Folder pushes are limited to four per setup per minute, so wait at least a minute after a rate-limit response.
staticText.LeLibrary indexes playable video files s: LeLibrary indexes playable video files such as MKV and MP4. It does not open or extract video files from inside a ZIP archive, so an archive by itself will not appear as a playable library item. If the provider exposes the extracted video files separately, those can be indexed on a later refresh.
staticText., then try another stream source or you: , then try another stream source or your own library copy. If the failing source is a TorBox library item, refresh the title and try again after a short wait so a fresh playback link can be requested. Re-adding the torrent should not be the first fix. If it keeps happening, report which provider and source failed without sharing your install link or API key.
staticText.Only after the other checks, and only if: Only after the other checks, and only if data still looks stale. Clearing cached data makes the next request rebuild it, which can make browsing briefly slower. It will not repair an invalid key or an upstream outage.
staticText.LeLibrary reads the downloads in your de: LeLibrary reads the downloads in your debrid account (TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize), groups series episodes into proper seasons, and matches everything to TMDB so each title has a poster, backdrop, rating and description. It also serves discovery rows, search and optional collection folders to Stremio and Nuvio.
staticText.Everything is one addon. There are no ac: Everything is one addon. There are no accounts, no sign-in and no email. A setup is a random id plus an install link, and a password you choose that only guards editing.
staticText.Public discovery rows let you browse tit: Public discovery rows let you browse titles you do not own. They are not playable on their own. Playback needs an owned file, one of your Custom Streams, or a configured external stream addon.
staticText.Every tier produces the same kind of set: Every tier produces the same kind of setup and the same install link. The tier only decides how much you fill in up front, and you can add the rest later by editing your setup.
staticText.Paste at least one debrid provider key a: Paste at least one debrid provider key and, for the best results, a TMDB key. Press the check button beside a field to verify a key live: green means the service accepted it, red shows the reason it did not.
staticText.Pick a poster provider and confirm the p: Pick a poster provider and confirm the preview. Settle In and Move In add home rows, stream filters and, in Move In, collections and artwork.
staticText.The password is the edit gate. Watching: The password is the edit gate. Watching never asks for it, and nobody can recover it for you, so save it somewhere safe.
staticText.A setup needs at least one provider key: A setup needs at least one provider key before it can be created. Custom Streams can run without a debrid provider, but you still need one key of any kind to save.
staticText.Keys are entered once while creating or: Keys are entered once while creating or editing a setup and are sealed on the server. They are never shown back to you. When you reopen a saved setup, the fields arrive filled with your saved values (hidden); leave a field alone to keep it, or type a new value to replace it.
staticText.TorBox supports torrents and Usenet. Rea: TorBox supports torrents and Usenet. Real-Debrid and AllDebrid cover torrents. Premiumize supports torrents and Usenet and may ask you to approve the new server location the first time it is used. You can add more than one: either combine them into a single library row or keep a separate row for each in Move In.
staticText.TMDB powers matching, posters, episode l: TMDB powers matching, posters, episode lists and search. Without it, LeLibrary falls back to limited metadata. A free TMDB API key from your TMDB account settings is enough.
staticText.The install link is your manifest.json U: The install link is your manifest.json URL. It carries your configuration but not your password, so your player needs no sign-in. Treat it as private: anyone who has it can use your setup and its connected services.
staticText.Copy your install link from the result s: Copy your install link from the result screen or from your setup editor.
staticText.Open Stremio and find the addon installe: Open Stremio and find the addon installer, then paste the link as an addon URL.
staticText.Confirm the installation. Opening the li: Confirm the installation. Opening the link alone does not install it.
staticText.Every stream row is formatted with a tem: Every stream row is formatted with a template, so a 62 GB Remux and a 4 GB WEB-DL read the same way. Pick a built-in preset or write your own name and description templates in the formatting section. The preview updates on a real sample filename as you type.
staticText.Filters keep the stream list to what you: Filters keep the stream list to what you will actually play: resolution, quality, source, minimum and maximum size, cached-only, plus finer codec, HDR and audio sets. They apply to your search results and stream lists, not to your library itself.
staticText.Owned copies come first. You can also en: Owned copies come first. You can also enable Torrentio, Comet, Meteor, MediaFusion, Jackettio or KNABEN, and set their priority. AIOStreams can be connected with its own manifest URL. LeLibrary reformats external results with your chosen look. KNABEN searches public torrent results and only contacts your selected debrid provider if you choose to play a result.
staticText.Custom Streams add your own direct HTTP: Custom Streams add your own direct HTTP or HTTPS links to a movie or an individual episode. A profile can run entirely from Custom Streams without a debrid provider, as long as you saved at least one key of another kind to create the setup.
staticText.Badge packs add small rating badges (IMD: Badge packs add small rating badges (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and friends) under each stream in Nuvio. They do not change anything in Stremio. Pick one of the ready-made packs or supply your own URL.
staticText.Home is the ordered list of rows on your: Home is the ordered list of rows on your home screen. Settle In and Move In let you tick the library rows you want (My Movies, My Shows and friends), add discovery rows such as Trending and Popular, rename them and drag them into the order you like.
staticText.By default library rows use LeLibrary's: By default library rows use LeLibrary's own isolated identifiers, which only LeLibrary answers. Turning on Use Main Meta serves eligible library titles with their IMDb IDs instead. That is what lets external stream addons answer them and what lets Nuvio enrich their detail pages. You can switch it on at any time; no reinstall is needed.
staticText.Move In adds the Collections Studio. Bui: Move In adds the Collections Studio. Build folders by hand, drop in a Quick Pack of ready-made collections, or let LeLibrary build owned movie collections from the franchises already in your library. Each folder can carry cover art and, in Nuvio, a focus animation. Pushing writes your folders to the selected Nuvio profile and leaves every other addon and user collection untouched.
staticText.Existing Nuvio folders fetch their conte: Existing Nuvio folders fetch their contents live, so new films appear without another push. A brand new franchise or a changed folder definition needs one more push to register. Pushes are limited to four per setup per minute.
staticText.Enter your password to unlock editing. I: Enter your password to unlock editing. If you created the setup in this browser it is remembered and offered back as a pill, though the password still guards every change.
Change anything and press Save changes. Saved keys reappear filled in but hidden; type over one to replace it, or leave it blank to keep it.
staticText.Delete everything from the danger zone i: Delete everything from the danger zone if you want the setup gone. Installed addon links stop working immediately and the sealed keys are removed.
staticText.The install link and the setup id are sh: The install link and the setup id are shown once when you create the setup. Reopen the setup with your password to see the install link again. If you lose both the id and the password, the setup cannot be recovered.
staticText.There are no accounts, no cookies, no an: There are no accounts, no cookies, no analytics and no tracking. Provider and metadata keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they touch disk and are never displayed back. Your password is hashed with scrypt and cannot be recovered by you or by us.
staticText.Wrong-password attempts are rate limited: Wrong-password attempts are rate limited per address for a few minutes to stop guessing. Those counters live in memory only.
staticText.When you ask for support, never post you: When you ask for support, never post your install link, a provider key, your setup id or a full media filename. A screenshot with keys and private links hidden is fine. Ask in the

staticText.The Stremio & Nuvio addon that organizes: The Stremio & Nuvio addon that organizes your TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, and Premiumize libraries with rich TMDB metadata.
Everything a setup stores, item by item.
staticText.Each setup gets a random identifier and: Each setup gets a random identifier and a random install secret. An optional label you type yourself (like “Living room”) is the only human-readable thing attached, and you can leave it blank.
staticText.Debrid keys (TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDeb: Debrid keys (TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize) and metadata keys (TMDB, TVDB, MDBList, OMDb, Fanart.tv, RPDB, ERDB) are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage. Your edit password is hashed with scrypt and can never be recovered, by you or by us.
staticText.Catalogue choices, home rows, stream fil: Catalogue choices, home rows, stream filters, artwork options and collection sources. Plain preferences, stored alongside the setup so your install link just works.
staticText.Wrong passwords are rate limited per add: Wrong passwords are rate limited per address for a few minutes to stop guessing. Those counters live in memory for about a minute and are never written to disk, the database or logs. The app sets no cookies at all. The Releases region choice is remembered in your browser, not on our servers.
What we never do, full stop.
staticText.No request logs tied to you: No request logs tied to you
staticText.There is no account to tie a log line to: There is no account to tie a log line to. Error messages may mention a media title if something goes wrong mid-match, but never your credentials. Reverse-proxy transport logs exist briefly for operating the site, as with any web server.
staticText.Nothing leaves except by your hand: Nothing leaves except by your hand
staticText.Your keys go only to the providers they: Your keys go only to the providers they belong to. Your install link works for whoever holds it, so sharing the link is sharing the setup: that choice, and its consequences, are entirely yours.
staticText.These services receive data only when yo: These services receive data only when you use the related feature. Each one processes your data under its own privacy policy.
staticText.Every library listing and stream link ca: Every library listing and stream link call authenticates directly to your provider with your key. They see the requests coming from our server, authenticated as you.
staticText.Title searches and detail lookups use yo: Title searches and detail lookups use your keys. Requests contain media titles and ids, never anything about you beyond the key itself. The hosted Releases browser is different: it uses LeLibrary's own shared TMDB key, not yours, and the title you type into its search box plus the region you pick are sent to TMDB to answer the lookup.
staticText.Optional artwork and rating providers. I: Optional artwork and rating providers. If configured, requests carry the relevant key and the title being looked up.
staticText.Selected Torrentio, Comet, Meteor, Media: Selected Torrentio, Comet, Meteor, MediaFusion and Jackettio configurations may receive the title ID and debrid credentials needed by those addons to search. KNABEN receives the title, year and episode details needed to search its public torrent index, never your debrid key. LeLibrary temporarily caches returned magnet links for up to 24 hours. When you select a KNABEN result, LeLibrary sends the torrent hash and your key to your configured debrid provider to resolve playback; that provider may add the selected torrent to your account.
staticText.Installing the addon hands your player t: Installing the addon hands your player the install link. Everything after that flows between your player, our server and your providers.
staticText.Kept until you stop using them. Rotating: Kept until you stop using them. Rotating the install secret kills the old link immediately; the sealed row behind it carries no identity, so there is nothing to trace back to you.
staticText.Wrong-password and abuse counters held i: Wrong-password and abuse counters held in process memory only. Never written to disk, database or logs.
staticText.Shared title-to-metadata mappings. Conta: Shared title-to-metadata mappings. Contain media titles and ids only, never personal data.
staticText.Daily database backups kept for operatio: Daily database backups kept for operational safety, then deleted on rotation. Backups are encrypted and contain the same sealed, unreadable rows.
staticText.Open your setup id in the editor: it sho: Open your setup id in the editor: it shows the tier, the label, which key services are saved and when it was last changed. Key values are never displayed, to anyone, ever.
staticText.Unlock with your password and overwrite: Unlock with your password and overwrite whatever you like: keys, preferences, artwork, rows. Saving replaces only what you send; everything else stays put.
staticText.There is no account to delete because th: There is no account to delete because there never was one. Rotate the install secret and the old link dies on the spot; keep your password to yourself and the setup is yours alone.
staticText.Questions or complaints: open an issue o: Questions or complaints: open an issue on GitHub or post on the subreddit. EU/UK residents keep their statutory rights of access, portability, rectification, erasure and objection, and we honour all of them.
staticText.LeLibrary (lelibrary.uk) is an open-sour: LeLibrary (lelibrary.uk) is an open-source project run as a hobbyist community service. For this hosted instance, the controller is the operator of lelibrary.uk. Contact:
staticText.To provide the service you asked for: ru: To provide the service you asked for: running your library, storing your preferences and serving your streams (performance of a contract). To protect the service from abuse: short-lived rate limiting (legitimate interests).
staticText.Some providers listed above (TMDB and th: Some providers listed above (TMDB and the debrid providers) process data outside the UK/EU. Using those features necessarily involves those transfers under each provider's own safeguards.
staticText.This policy covers the hosted service at: This policy covers the hosted service at lelibrary.uk. If you self-host LeLibrary, all data stays on hardware you control and this policy doesn't apply; you become the data controller instead.
staticText.If this policy changes materially, the u: If this policy changes materially, the updated date above will change and notable differences will be summarised on the home page or release notes. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated version.
staticText.LeLibrary is a debrid library addon for: LeLibrary is a debrid library addon for Nuvio and Stremio. It brings your saved movies, shows and anime into your player, organizes them with artwork and metadata, and helps you play files you already have.
staticText.Does LeLibrary work with TorBox in Nuvio: Does LeLibrary work with TorBox in Nuvio?
staticText.Yes. LeLibrary connects your TorBox libr: Yes. LeLibrary connects your TorBox library to Nuvio and can push your setup into your Nuvio profile, so your library and collections are ready to browse there.
staticText.Can I use LeLibrary with Stremio?: Can I use LeLibrary with Stremio?
staticText.Yes. Install your LeLibrary setup in Str: Yes. Install your LeLibrary setup in Stremio to browse your debrid library, collections and supported discovery catalogs alongside your other addons.
staticText.Does it skip choosing a stream?: Does it skip choosing a stream?
staticText.When a playable copy is already in a con: When a playable copy is already in a connected debrid library, LeLibrary prioritizes that copy. In supported players, you can press Play without sorting through a list of duplicate results.
staticText.Will LeLibrary add duplicate torrents to: Will LeLibrary add duplicate torrents to my debrid account?
staticText.Browsing with LeLibrary or playing a sav: Browsing with LeLibrary or playing a saved title does not add another torrent to your debrid account. It reuses a playable file already in your connected library.
staticText.How do I set up LeLibrary?: How do I set up LeLibrary?
staticText.Open the setup page, choose your debrid: Open the setup page, choose your debrid provider and player, then follow the steps to connect and install. The guided setup creates the addon link for Nuvio or Stremio.
staticText.Does LeLibrary only work with TorBox?: Does LeLibrary only work with TorBox?
staticText.No. LeLibrary supports TorBox, Real-Debr: No. LeLibrary supports TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Premiumize. Choose one provider or combine them in one setup.
staticText.Your library, formatters and streams, de: Your library, formatters and streams, debrid and custom sources, posters, Nuvio badge packs and your MDBList key.
staticText.You want to start watching now and do no: You want to start watching now and do not care about ordering the home screen yet.
staticText.Everything in Quick Look, plus home rows: Everything in Quick Look, plus home rows (Trending, Popular and friends) and stream filters for resolution, size, quality, cached and audio.
staticText.Recommended for most people. It gets you: Recommended for most people. It gets your home screen and your stream list to look the way you watch.
staticText.Everything in Settle In, plus the full v: Everything in Settle In, plus the full visual collection wizard, Nuvio collections and artwork management.
staticText.You want folders, franchises and cover a: You want folders, franchises and cover art, and you are happy to push the result straight to a Nuvio profile.
staticText.Catalogue browsing, owned franchises use: Catalogue browsing, owned franchises use a genre dropdown
